goals_autor_ou_lado.name: goals_autor_ou_lado
goals_autor_ou_lado.value: "goals"."player_id" is not null or "goals"."side" is not null

match_days_duracao_check.name: match_days_duracao_check
match_days_duracao_check.value: "match_days"."end_time" is null or ("match_days"."start_time" is not null and (case when "match_days"."end_time" > "match_days"."start_time" then "match_days"."end_time" - "match_days"."start_time" else "match_days"."end_time" - "match_days"."start_time" + interval '24 hours' end) between interval '30 minutes' and interval '6 hours')

zenha_apostas_resolucao_junta.name: zenha_apostas_resolucao_junta
zenha_apostas_resolucao_junta.value: ("zenha_apostas"."resolvida_em" is null) = ("zenha_apostas"."desfecho" is null) and ("zenha_apostas"."resolvida_em" is null) = ("zenha_apostas"."retorno" is null)

zenha_apostas_retorno_coerente.name: zenha_apostas_retorno_coerente
zenha_apostas_retorno_coerente.value:
"zenha_apostas"."desfecho" is null
        or ("zenha_apostas"."desfecho" = 'perdida' and "zenha_apostas"."retorno" = 0)
        or ("zenha_apostas"."desfecho" in ('devolvida', 'cancelada') and "zenha_apostas"."retorno" = "zenha_apostas"."valor")
        or ("zenha_apostas"."desfecho" = 'paga' and "zenha_apostas"."retorno" >= "zenha_apostas"."valor")
